Why do you need a Social Media Manager?

Before: you do it all

Zoom ↓

A feed with no plan or theme.

  • You make every post yourself, between running your business.
  • Posts go up when you have time, not on a plan.
  • Colors, fonts and photos change from post to post.
  • Nobody checks your reach, follows or what works.

After

The same feed, planned and designed by me.

  • I plan, design and schedule every post.
  • You get a content calendar and approval sheet every two weeks.
  • One theme and one color palette on every post.
  • A monthly report shows you what is working.

Restaurant package

Social media manager vs digital marketing manager

Two different jobs. Here is the short version.

This package

Social Media Manager

Goal: get you noticed

  • Plans and designs your Instagram posts
  • Makes Reels and edits your videos
  • Schedules your posts
  • Keeps your feed on brand
  • Sends a monthly report
Separate

Digital Marketing Manager

Goal: get you sales

  • Runs paid ads
  • Plans campaigns across channels
  • Tracks clicks, leads and sales
  • Manages the ad budget

Here's what you get every month

$450 AUDper month

On your Instagram

  • 12 creative feed posts
  • 2 creative Reels
  • Planned grid

What I send you

  • Client brief
  • Content strategy
  • Content calendar
  • Monthly report
  • Content approval sheets

Meta ads aren't included. I offer them separately.
